name: Space Hitchhiker Stop
detailed_description:
Welcome to Space Hitchhiker Stop, you are a dude working in a Hitchhiker Stop, in Space.

You're being hunted down by the mafia and have to work for them in order to upgrade your ship and escape Space.

In this game you'll have to manage your resources by creating crates so that the mafia customers come into your store and you get the moneyz from them. Remember that if you don't buy boxes and create supplies, you'll run out of them! Causing your mafia clients to not come into your store because you have nothing to sell. And so you'll go bankrupt, and they'll kill you.

If you have enough coin, you're also able to purchase upgrades, these three upgrades come with many tiers, you're able to make the customer have a bigger temper, they pay you more money and to make your energy last longer! You are also able to upgrade the generators, which will make their crafting time even faster!

The goal of the game is to fully upgrade your ship and to escape the mafia by hyperdriving away from Space. Be wary of your energy and your bills, if you go bankrupt, the mafia will kill you (as we already said before). If you run out of energy you'll simply die, as is the rules of space and time fluctuation and many more rules there are.

-- The mafia
